transcript.content: Hello, it's nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well, to be honest with you, I'm here because I've been acting... out of character lately. I help out at the community center sometimes, and the other day, I just blew up at one of the younger volunteers. Yelled at him, over a tablecloth being crooked of all things. I don't usually talk to people that way. It's just not like me.
Have there been times when you needed much less sleep than usual but still felt rested?
No, I can't say that's happened. If I don't get my regular sleep, I definitely feel it the next day. I haven't had any times where I felt rested or full of energy on just a little bit of sleep, no.
Have you had other sudden angry outbursts like this?

Well, no, not really. Like I mentioned just a minute ago, it was really just that one time with the younger volunteer and the tablecloth. That's the main thing that brought me in, because it was just so out of the blue. I haven't had other big blow-ups... it's just that one really bothered me because, well, I just don't talk to people that way.
Was there a significant stressful event or change in your life shortly before this incident?
Yes, there was. All of this has been going on for about a week now, ever since there was a robbery outside the bank. I guess that really rattled me a lot more than I thought.
During the robbery, were you personally threatened with serious injury or death, or did you witness someone being seriously injured or threatened?

No, thankfully not. I wasn't right in the middle of it, so they didn't point a weapon at me or threaten me directly. And... well, I didn't see anyone get hurt, either. I was just close enough to see it all happening and hear the yelling, but nobody was injured that I know of.
Since the robbery, have you felt persistently depressed or unusually low in mood?
No, I wouldn't say I've been depressed. I mean, I haven't been feeling low or anything like that. Just... on edge, I suppose. But my mood itself hasn't been down.
Since the robbery, have these changes caused significant problems in your work, relationships, or daily life?

Well, I don't work anymore, so that's not an issue. But my day-to-day life... yeah, it's definitely been affected. I haven't been able to keep up with organizing the Día de los Muertos event the way I usually do. I just don't have it in me right now. And... well, I've also stopped going to my regular card nights. I just don't feel very steady around people at the moment, so I've been staying home instead.
Since the robbery, have you been feeling unusually anxious or on edge?

Well, like I mentioned a minute ago, I do feel a little on edge. But I wouldn't say I'm unusually anxious. I'm not sitting around worrying all day or anything like that. It's just... I guess I'm just a bit more cautious right now. But no, no real heavy anxiety.
During the incident at the community center, did you threaten or physically intimidate the younger volunteer?

No, I didn't threaten him or get physical. But... well, that incident is actually what brought me in here. I blew up at one of the younger volunteers just over a crooked tablecloth. I raised my voice and really lost my temper. I don't usually talk to people that way, so it didn't sit right with me.
